{{Quote|They said it would be easy to wash away the memories of battle on a watery world. I guess they never saw an entire ocean run red.|[[Rin Mako]]|<ref name="Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Glee Anselm''' was a battle fought at [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rin Mako]] fought in this battle.
